values.summary: After WP-20 and the rollback gate, pin the deletion denominator, inventory every legacy owner/reference, close capability gaps, delete in validated ownership bands, prove thin-CLI/runtime/platform parity, and publish exact reduction and exception truth.

steps.action: Verify WP-20 terminal ancestry, rollback-window expiry, rollback disposition, selector health, and exact baseline measurement.
Generate the exhaustive legacy and reverse-reference inventory; close or route every missing owner and capability gap.
Delete one exact ownership band at a time while preserving supported CLI, artifact, trace, failure, and rollback contracts.
Run denominator, parity, negative, clean-install, and macOS/Linux platform proof and restore any failing band.
Retain exact counts/exceptions, resolve independent review findings, and publish the reviewed closing PR.

affected_areas: adl/Cargo.toml, adl/Cargo.lock, workflows, installers, tools, docs, and demos only where deleted owners remain referenced
adl-v2, adl-runtime-kernel, or csdlc-v2 only for a proven replacement gap
invariants: No scope absorption across work packages
Evidence claims remain exact-revision and source-grounded
stop_conditions: Required proof cannot be produced within issue scope
